payload.description:
Feature: Jev whole-scorecard prediction

  Scenario: Whole-scorecard prediction sends one request
    Given a Jev scorecard with two scores
    When the scorecard predicts an item
    Then exactly one Jev request is sent and both scores have results

  Scenario: Individual score predictions share the cached result
    Given a Jev scorecard with two scores
    When Score.predict() is called for each score on the same item in sequence or concurrently
    Then only one Jev request is sent and each call returns its own score result

  Scenario: A different item triggers a new request
    Given a cached result for one item
    When a different item is predicted
    Then a new Jev request is sent
payload.title: One Jev request serves all scores for an item
